items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: I started working with them, it was Lee Collins, Fess Jones, myself, Daniel Barker, Roy Evans, and Joe Rovershue.

ctx.x: He told Fess Jones and the fellas about me. And I started working with them, it was Lee Collins, Fess Jones, myself, Daniel Barker, Roy Evans, and Joe Rovershue.
Oh yeah. Most of those people, Lee Collins died about a year ago. Several of them are still around.

items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: Sundoon, he's a New York man, he was a banjo player.

ctx.x: Yeah. Used to have music for, they still do, sometimes when they open a restaurant or something. Oh, yeah.

And we used to, after we got known a little, Detective Lennice and Reagan used to hire us regularly for their little art and used to pay for them. Oh, yeah. And after that I think I went to Biloxi, Mississippi with Isaiah Morgan I think. And Sundoon, he's a New York man, he was a banjo player.

items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: Oh yeah, I never even knew anything.

ctx.x: That's in relation to Paul Barberand. He's a banjo player, he's a New York man. Oh, wait a minute. Barker. Oh yeah, sure.
Yeah, we called him Sundoon. Oh yeah, I never even knew anything.
